## Problem and change

Describe the concrete problem and resulting behavior. Link the issue if there is one.

## Validation

List the exact commands and real results, or explain a docs-only review. For a race reproduction, include the spec, schedule, runtime identity and expected result. Attach a rendered preview for visible changes.

## Review checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and respects the public repository's curated scope.
- [ ] Commands, package versions, links and support claims were checked.
- [ ] Examples are synthetic and contain no credentials, private paths or customer data.
- [ ] Measured claims include their method and limits.
